description: This Java source file defines the class DebugManagedDataSource, which extends ManagedDataSource to add debugging and informational features for database connection pooling and management within the OFBiz framework. It provides overridden methods for obtaining connections with verbose logging and a method to retrieve detailed pool statistics.

classes.name: DebugManagedDataSource
classes.description: A subclass of ManagedDataSource that adds debugging features, including verbose connection borrowing logs and a method to retrieve pool statistics.

methods.name: DebugManagedDataSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the data source with a pool and transaction registry.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Overrides the parent class method to add verbose debugging output when acquiring a connection.

methods.description: Returns a map containing detailed information about the connection pool's current state and configuration, for debugging and monitoring purposes.
